description: This file contains tests for error handling functions in the 'interactors' package, specifically testing functions like ExistingErrorOr and AnyError to ensure correct error propagation and logic.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrTT
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr returns the first existing error when both inputs are errors.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrTF
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr short circuits if the first argument is an error.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrFT
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr returns the second error generated by the function when the first argument is nil.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrFF
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr returns nil when both inputs are nil.

methods.name: TestAnyErrorPositive
methods.description: Tests that AnyError returns the first non-nil error provided.

methods.name: TestAnyErrorNegative
methods.description: Tests that AnyError returns nil when no errors are provided.
